visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular man wearing a black athletic t-shirt sits behind a table cluttered with various packaged convenience foods. The setting appears to be a bright indoor studio with a white wall and a light switch visible in the background, illuminated by soft studio lighting. (2) Cut to an outdoor scene where the man, now shirtless and wearing grey shorts, is running dynamically on a red athletic track. He is surrounded by lush green trees and academic-looking urban buildings under bright natural daylight, showing intense physical exertion. (3) Scene shifts to a mirror-filled room, likely a home gym or physical therapy studio, where the man poses shirtless. He meticulously displays his muscular physique, shoulder definition, and core strength from multiple angles while standing on a patterned floor. (4) Back in the indoor studio, the man picks up and gestures towards specific food items on the table. These include frozen sweet potatoes, containers of yogurt, and pre-packaged meal boxes with distinctive yellow and green labels, highlighting their convenience for his diet. (5) A high-detail close-up shot focuses on a smartphone screen displaying the FitHub app interface. It tracks specific calories and macro-nutrients. The phone is held by the man's arm, which features a prominent black tattoo, against a transparent glass table background.
